hero.headline: Hi, I'm Bhushan
hero.subtext: I bring a strong mix of business strategy and deep technical expertise to turn big ideas into real-world solutions. Passionate about bridging business needs with emerging technologies through Agile, SAFe®, and design thinking.

coreCompetencies.label: Product Strategy & Agile Leadership
coreCompetencies.description: Expert in defining vision, roadmaps, and technical backlogs, ensuring seamless execution of business-driven solutions through Agile and SAFe® methodologies.

coreCompetencies.label: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
coreCompetencies.description: Specialize in Generative AI, Conversational AI, NLP, RAG pipelines, and LLMs (OpenAI, Google Gemini) to enable AI-powered automation, personalization, and business transformation.

coreCompetencies.label: Cloud & DevOps
coreCompetencies.description: Strong foundation in Azure cloud platforms, Databricks, MLOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring scalable and secure deployments.

coreCompetencies.label: Data Engineering
coreCompetencies.description: Design and implement robust pipelines for structured, unstructured, and geospatial data using Azure Databricks, Data Lake, and orchestration tools.

coreCompetencies.label: Technical Leadership & Communication
coreCompetencies.description: Skilled at bridging the gap between business and technology, effectively articulating strategies to executives, engineers, and product teams, and a focus on long-term value.

coreCompetencies.label: System Architecture & Emerging Tech
coreCompetencies.description: Design microservices-based and event-driven systems; explore Blockchain, IoT, Spatial & Quantum Computing.

coreCompetencies.label: Prototyping & Development
coreCompetencies.description: Skilled in Python (Pandas, NumPy, LangChain), Angular, React, Django, and Flask for building AI prototypes and scalable applications.

aboutMe.desc: I'm a UX designer with over 5 years of experience in creating user-friendly and visually appealing digital products. My expertise lies in user research, interaction design, and prototyping. I'm passionate about understanding user needs and translating them into effective design solutions. I've worked with a variety of clients, from startups to large corporations, and I'm always eager to take on new challenges.
aboutMe.quote: Great architecture isn't just scalable. It's thoughtful, ethical, and built for the people who use it.
